status: verified locally; production verification follows deployment
features: Journal index and individual reading pages at /blog.
Owner editor at /blog/write, using existing owner sign-in.
Private drafts, explicit publication, updates, unpublish; stable unique entry URLs.
Optional topic, summary and public HTTPS cover; headings, lists and quotes; no raw HTML execution.
Journal linked from projects and resources; sitemap contains published entries only.

checks.result: 25 unit tests, Next build, bundle privacy gate, 72 API assertions and cloud regression gate passed.
Additional missing-journal lookup returned promptly through actual Next cloud wrapper.

checks.command: npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint [changed TS/TSX files]

chrome.store: Separate local test store; no demo entry written to production.
tested: Save private draft, publish, read via public URL, return to draft, confirm empty public index.
320px editor and reading page: no horizontal overflow; vertical scrolling observed.
Heading, list and quotation formatting renders as expected.

review.result: Reviewed private read/publish guards, same-origin checks, stale revisions, immutable URLs, content bounds, HTML escaping and sitemap filtering. No open finding >=4.

caveats: Journal is empty until the owner publishes a real entry. No authored opinions or demo posts were invented for production.
Editor supports paragraphs, headings, lists and quotes; cover images use a public HTTPS URL.
No autosave; use Save draft or Save changes.
Journal is the working English name, Diario in Spanish; name preference was requested.

calibration.claim: Journal can reuse existing owner session and versioned storage while keeping drafts private
Publication makes an entry publicly readable and unpublishing removes it from index, URL and sitemap
